paite: Huan Paikan Ankuangluina ding ni guk a-om lai a, Jesu'n misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh Lazaras omna khua, Bethani ahong tung hi.
heading: Bethani A Jesu Thaunilhna / (Mat 26.6-13; Mar 14.3-9)

paite: Huai ah amah a ding in nitak an abawl ua, Martha in nek abawl hi, Lazaras bel a-ankuang umpih khat ahi.
Mari in spiknardi buk kimkhat thaunamtui manphatak ahon tawi a, Jesu khete anuh a, asam in anul a, huai thaugim in insung adimta hi.
Himahleh Judas Iskariot, anungzuite lak a khat, amansak ding pa'n,
"Hiai thaunamtui bangziak a makhai zathum a zuak a migentheite kiang a pe zaw lou uh ahia?" achi hi.
Migentheite a-awlmoh ziak a hiai thu gen ahi kei; amah guta ahi a, dangka ip akem a, asung a koih a alak zel ziak ahi zaw hi.
Jesu'n, "Subuai kei un, ka kivui ni a dia asit ahi.
Na kiang ua migentheite om gige ahi ua, kei bel na kiang ua om gige ding ka hi kei,” achi hi.
Huan huai mun ah Jesu a-om chih Juda mipite'n atheih un; ahong ua, Jesu ziak kia hilou in, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, Lazaras mah leng amuh nop ziak uh ahi.
heading: Lazaras Thah Sawmna

paite: Huan siampu liante Lazaras leng thah ding in akihou uhi.
Amah ziak a Judate tampi in langkaisan a, Jesu agintak ziak un.
Azing in, Ankuangluina a hong mipi tampi'n Jerusalem ah Jesu ahong pai ding chih azak un,
heading: Jesu Vualzou A Jerusalem Lutna / (Mat 21.1-11; Mar 11.1-11; Luk 19.28-40)

paite: tumnahte atawi ua, dawn ding in apawtkhia ua, "Hosanna! Toupa min a Israelte Kumpipa hong pai ahampha e!" chi in akikou uhi.
Huan Jesu'n sabiltungnou amu a, atung ah atuang hi.
"Lau ke'n, Zion tanu; en in, na Kumpipa, sabiltungnou tung a tuang in, ahong pai ding," chih gelh ahih bang in.
Huai thute atung in anungzuite'n atheisiam kei ua; himahleh, Jesu pahtawi ahih nung in, atanchin ah huai thu gelh ahi chih leh amah tung ah huai thilte akihih ngei chih atheita uhi.
Huan han a kipan asapkhiakpa Lazaras, misi lak a kipan akaihthoh lai a akiang a mipi omte'n, athu atheihpih uhi.
Huaiziak in ahi, mipite'n leng amah ava dawn uh; huai thillamdang ahih chih atheih ziak un.
Huchi in Pharisaite'n, "Thei un, bangmah na hihtheih louh uh, en un, khovel in amah azuita,” akichi uhi.
Huan ankuangluina a Pathian be ding a hohtoute lak ah Grik kuate hiam a-om uhi.
heading: Grikte Ngetna

paite: Huaite Galili gam a Bethsaida a mi Philip kiang ah ahong ua, akiang ah, "Pu, Jesu ka mu nuam uh," achi ua, angen uhi.
Philip in Andru ahong hilh a, Andru leh Philip in Jesu ahong hilh uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa pahtawi a a-omna ding hun atungta hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei a buhtang akiak a, asih phot keileh amah kia in a-om tawntung; asih in bel, tampi in agah hi.
Kuapeuh ahinna it in amangsak ding a; kuapeuh hiai khovel a ahinna ngaineu in tangtawn hinna ah akem ding hi.
Kuapeuh in ka nna asepleh hon zui hen; ka omna ah ka sikha leng a-om ding hi; kuapeuh in kanna asepleh Pa'n amah apahtawi ding hi.
"Tu in ka kha amangbang mahmah; bang ka genta dia? 'Pa, hiai hun a pan hon hondam in, ka chi dia hia?' Himahleh hiai ding ziak mah a hiai hun a hong pai lah ka ngal a.
heading: Jesu Sih Ding Genkholhna

paite: Pa na min pahtawi in," achi hi. Huchi in van a kipan in aw ahong suak a, "Ka pahtawita, ka pahtawi nawn lai ding,” achi hi.
Mipi akiang a dinghte'n huai aza ua, "Vanpiging ahi," achi ua; midangte'n, "Angel in amah houpih ahi," achi uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "Huai aw kei a dia hong suak ahi kei, noumau a ding ahi zaw," achi hi.
"Tu hiai khovel thukhensakna hun ahi; tu hiai khovel lal paihkhiak hun ahi.
Huan lei a kipan a khaikang a ka omleh, mi tengteng keimah kiang ah ka hip ding," achi hi.
Huai thu asihdan ding theihsakna dia agen ahi.
Huan mipi'n akiang ah, "Khrist tangtawn in a-om chih Dan Bu ah ka thei uh, nang Mihing Tapa khaikang a om ding ka hi, bangchi chih a chi na hia? Huai Mihing Tapa kua ahia?" achi ua, adong uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lak uah sawt lou sung vak a-om tadih hi. Huai vak na neih sung un vak ah khosa un, huchi lou in zaw mial in ahon lap ding hi. Kuapeuh mial a khosa in apaina athei kei hi.
Vak na neih sung un vak gingta un, vak tate na hong hihtheihna ding un," achi hi. Huai thute Jesu'n agen a; huan apai a, amuh louh ding un akiselta hi.
Ama uah huchi tel a tam thillamdang hih mahleh, amah agingta tuan kei uh.
heading: Judate Leh Ginglou Mipite

paite: "Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta? Toupa khut leng kua kiang ah ahia latsak a a-om?" chi a zawlnei Isai thugen atangtunna ding in.
Hiai ziak in ahi a gintak theih louh uh, Isai in,

"Ama'n amit uh ahihtaw a, alungtang uh ahihkhauh; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu kha ding ua, alungtang un athei kha ding uh, huan hong kihei nawn ding ua, ke'n amau ka hihdam kha ding," chih agen nawn ziak in.
Hiai thilte Isai in athupina amuh a atanchin agen ahi.
Himahleh, heutute lak nangawn ah tampi in Jesu agingta uhi; himahleh Pharisaite ziak in akipulak nuam kei uh, huchi lou in zaw sinagog a kipan ahawlkhe kha ding uhi;
Pathian pahtakna sang a mihing pahtakna adeih zawk ziak un.
Huan Jesu akikou a, "Kuapeuh hon gingta, kei hon gingta ahi kei a, hon sawlpa gingta ahi zaw hi.
heading: Jesu'n Vantang A Thuhilhna

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon mu hon sawlpa mu ahi.
Khovel a vak hong pai pen ka hi, kuapeuh kei hon gingta mial a a-omlouhna ding in.
Kuapeuh ka thugen za in, gingta kei mahleh, ke'n siam louh ka tangsak kei; khovel siam louh tangsak ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, khovel humbit ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
Kuapeuh kei hon deih lou a, ka thugente pom lou in, siam louh tangsak khat anei hi, ka thugen huai thu mahmah in, nitawp ni chiang in amah siam louh atangsak ding hi.
Keimah phuahtawm in thu ka gen kei a; Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thugen ding leh ka hih ding thu ahon pe zaw hi.
Amah thupiak tangtawn hinna ahi chih ka thei; huaiziak in ka thugen, Pa hon hilh bang zel in ka gen ahi," achi hi.
